pridemonth_1: Hey, y_c! Look what I took from that big Twoleg party by the Twolegplace!
[In t_c's mouth is a small, round object, coloured pink, blue, and white.]
I'm not sure what it is, but it spoke to me!
pridemonth_2: All the colourful Twoleg parties going on lately make me think we should be celebrating more often, too.
No everyone is strong enough to be a Clan cat. We should be proud of ourselves!
pridemonth_3: I'm very proud of you, y_c. You're a good cat.
Not sure why I felt so suddenly compelled to tell you that, but I did. I should say it more often.
pridemonth_4: Oh, my StarClan. I just accidentally wandered into that big, colourful Twoleg party at the edge of the Twolegplace while hunting.
You know, Twolegs are usually scary, but these ones looked nice! They were all having fun, and they stared at me, but they didn't chase me down.
Don't worry, I'm not gonna run away to become a kitypet... I'm just glad to know that not all Twolegs are mean.
pridemonth_5: I've been watching my Twolegs celebrating... I wish I could be there with them this year.
pridemonth_6: Even with my declining hearing, I can hear those Twoleg parties while I'm trying to relax in camp!
Good for them for having fun... but I'd like a bit of peace and quiet in my afternoon.
pridemonth_7: Hi, y_c! You're doing great. I hope you're feeling proud of yourself today.
